title: #85 – Roger Penrose: Physics of Consciousness and the Infinite Universe
summary: Roger Penrose is physicist, mathematician, and philosopher at University of Oxford. He has made fundamental contributions in many disciplines from the mathematical physics of general relativity and cosmology to the limitations of a computational view of consciousness.
